factories.name: new_create_card_checkout_session_step
factories.description: Create one Stripe-hosted Checkout Session for a card payment; keep any overridden retry window at most 23 hours, below the 24 hours that Stripe keeps idempotency keys.

inputSchema.description: CreateCardCheckoutSessionInput is one hosted card Checkout request. Its fields have the same meanings and validation as CreateACHCheckoutSessionInput.

cancelUrl.description: CancelURL is the HTTPS location Stripe uses when the customer cancels Checkout.

clientReferenceId.description: ClientReferenceID correlates the session with one non-sensitive application record.

currency.description: Currency is the lowercase three-letter currency code.

customerEmail.description: CustomerEmail is the plain email address Stripe pre-fills in hosted Checkout.

expiresAt.description: ExpiresAt optionally requests a provider expiration timestamp.

metadata.description: Metadata is bounded non-sensitive application metadata copied to the session and PaymentIntent.

productName.description: ProductName is the ticket or event label displayed by hosted Checkout.

successUrl.description: SuccessURL is the HTTPS location Stripe uses after Checkout succeeds.

unitAmount.description: UnitAmount is the positive ticket price in the currency's minor unit.

factories.name: new_create_ach_checkout_session_step
factories.description: Create one Stripe-hosted Checkout Session for a US bank account payment; keep any overridden retry window at most 23 hours, below the 24 hours that Stripe keeps idempotency keys.

inputSchema.description: CreateACHCheckoutSessionInput contains one Stripe-hosted ACH Checkout request.

cancelUrl.description: CancelURL is the HTTPS location Stripe uses when the customer cancels Checkout.

clientReferenceId.description: ClientReferenceID correlates the session with one non-sensitive application record.

currency.description: Currency is the lowercase three-letter currency code.

customerEmail.description: CustomerEmail is the plain email address Stripe pre-fills in hosted Checkout.

expiresAt.description: ExpiresAt optionally requests a provider expiration timestamp.

metadata.description: Metadata is bounded non-sensitive application metadata copied to the session and PaymentIntent.

productName.description: ProductName is the ticket or event label displayed by hosted Checkout.

successUrl.description: SuccessURL is the HTTPS location Stripe uses after Checkout succeeds.

unitAmount.description: UnitAmount is the positive ticket price in the currency's minor unit.

factories.name: new_get_checkout_session_step
factories.description: Retrieve one Checkout Session by Stripe ID.

inputSchema.description: GetCheckoutSessionInput identifies one Stripe Checkout Session.

sessionId.description: SessionID is Stripe's Checkout Session identifier.

factories.name: new_get_payment_intent_step
factories.description: Retrieve one PaymentIntent with its refunded amount and customer email.

paymentIntentId.description: PaymentIntentID is Stripe's PaymentIntent identifier, beginning with pi_.

factories.name: new_create_refund_step
factories.description: Refund part or all of one Stripe PaymentIntent. Give the amount in the currency's minor unit, such as cents.

inputSchema.description: CreateRefundInput contains one Stripe refund request.

amount.description: Amount is the positive refund amount in the currency's minor unit.

metadata.description: Metadata is bounded non-sensitive application metadata stored on the refund.

paymentIntentId.description: PaymentIntentID is the Stripe PaymentIntent to refund, beginning with pi_.

reason.description: Reason optionally classifies the refund as duplicate, fraudulent, or requested_by_customer.
